item.title: Bulletin updated at 07:50 HKT 01/Feb/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The northeast monsoon affecting southern China will continue to moderate today. Temperatures will rise further over the region. The strong easterly airstream is expected to affect the coast of Guangdong in the latter part of this week and over the weekend. Meanwhile, an upper-air disturbance will bring rainy weather to the region. With the upper-air disturbance departing, the weather will be brighter over the coast of southern China early next week.
